experience.condition: Incorrect use of v-model on a file input in a Vue.js component
experience.lesson: Using v-model on a file input can cause rendering issues and obstruct user interaction due to the read-only nature of file inputs.
experience.recommended_action: Replace v-model with v-on:change for file inputs to properly handle file uploads and avoid rendering errors.
experience.verification: After changing v-model to v-on:change for the file input, the page should render without errors, allowing the user to interact with the form and submit the report.

added.key: compile:v-model cannot be used on file inputs since they are read-only. Use a v-on:change listener instead.

supported: compile:v-model cannot be used on a prop, because local prop bindings are not writable.
